End-to-end acceptance over the real HTTP entry point:\n//! two writers started on the same snapshot are interleaved with a long\n//! reader; the first commit wins, the second gets 409; GC while the reader is\n//! pinned cannot remove its history; after release the space is reclaimed.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_reclaim::http::Server;\nuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, StdIo};\n\nfn start(dir: &std::path::Path) -> String {\n    let server = Server::new(dir).unwrap();\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    // Keep the server alive for the whole test.\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port())\n}\n\nfn jget(addr: &str, path: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"GET\", path, \"\")\n}\nfn jpost(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"POST\", path, body)\n}\nfn jput(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"PUT\", path, body)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_writers_conflict_long_reader_and_gc() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-acceptance\");\n    let addr = start(&dir);\n\n    // Seed v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let w0 = common::int(&r.body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"v1\"}},{\"put\":{\"k\":\"y\",\"v\":\"y1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"buffered\"), 2);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n\n    // Long reader pins v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/read\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n    let reader = common::int(&r.body, \"read_txn_id\");\n\n    // Reader sees v1 content.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.raw.trim_matches('\"').len() > 0, true);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Writer A and B both snapshot v1.\n    let wa = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let wb = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"A\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"B\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // A commits (v2).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 2);\n\n    // B commits -> 409 conflict, names x.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"error\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"write-write conflict\"));\n    let keys = match r.body.get(\"keys\") {\n        Some(mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a)) => a\n            .iter()\n            .map(|j| j.as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n        other => panic!(\"expected keys array, got {other:?}\"),\n    };\n    assert_eq!(keys, vec![\"x\"]);\n\n    // Latest state reflects A only.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"A\"));\n\n    // The long reader STILL sees v1.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=y\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"y1\"));\n\n    // Create more history to have something reclaimable once the reader goes.\n    for i in 0..5 {\n        let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n        let body = format!(r#\"{{\"ops\":[{{\"put\":{{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"n{i}\"}}}}]}}\"#);\n        assert_eq!(jput(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"), &body).status, 200);\n        assert_eq!(\n            jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n            200\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Stats while the reader is active list it and pin watermark to 1.\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&st.body, \"watermark\"), 1);\n    let snaps = st.body.get(\"snapshots\").unwrap();\n    let snap_count = match snaps {\n        mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a) => a.len(),\n        _ => panic!(\"snapshots not array\"),\n    };\n    assert!(snap_count >= 1);\n\n    // GC with active reader must not break the reader (watermark 1 keeps all\n    // versions >= 1 — reader stays valid).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/gc\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jget(&addr, assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/release\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    let before = common::int(&st.body, \"file_bytes\");\n    let reclaimable = common::int(&st.body, \"reclaimable_bytes\");\n    assert!(reclaimable > 0, \"expected reclaimable bytes, got {reclaimable}\");\n\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"after\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, Some(\"after\"));\n\n    // Abort path leaves nothing behind.\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/abort\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n        404\n    );\n\n    // End-to-end acceptance over the real HTTP entry point:\n//! two writers started on the same snapshot are interleaved with a long\n//! reader; the first commit wins, the second gets 409; GC while the reader is\n//! pinned cannot remove its history; after release the space is reclaimed.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_reclaim::http::Server;\nuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, StdIo};\n\nfn start(dir: &std::path::Path) -> String {\n    let server = Server::new(dir).unwrap();\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    // Keep the server alive for the whole test.\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port())\n}\n\nfn jget(addr: &str, path: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"GET\", path, \"\")\n}\nfn jpost(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"POST\", path, body)\n}\nfn jput(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"PUT\", path, body)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_writers_conflict_long_reader_and_gc() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-acceptance\");\n    let addr = start(&dir);\n\n    // Seed v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let w0 = common::int(&r.body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"v1\"}},{\"put\":{\"k\":\"y\",\"v\":\"y1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"buffered\"), 2);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n\n    // Long reader pins v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/read\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n    let reader = common::int(&r.body, \"read_txn_id\");\n\n    // Reader sees v1 content.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.raw.trim_matches('\"').len() > 0, true);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Writer A and B both snapshot v1.\n    let wa = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let wb = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"A\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"B\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // A commits (v2).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 2);\n\n    // B commits -> 409 conflict, names x.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"error\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"write-write conflict\"));\n    let keys = match r.body.get(\"keys\") {\n        Some(mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a)) => a\n            .iter()\n            .map(|j| j.as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n        other => panic!(\"expected keys array, got {other:?}\"),\n    };\n    assert_eq!(keys, vec![\"x\"]);\n\n    // Latest state reflects A only.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"A\"));\n\n    // The long reader STILL sees v1.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=y\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"y1\"));\n\n    // Create more history to have something reclaimable once the reader goes.\n    for i in 0..5 {\n        let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n        let body = format!(r#\"{{\"ops\":[{{\"put\":{{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"n{i}\"}}}}]}}\"#);\n        assert_eq!(jput(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"), &body).status, 200);\n        assert_eq!(\n            jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n            200\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Stats while the reader is active list it and pin watermark to 1.\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&st.body, \"watermark\"), 1);\n    let snaps = st.body.get(\"snapshots\").unwrap();\n    let snap_count = match snaps {\n        mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a) => a.len(),\n        _ => panic!(\"snapshots not array\"),\n    };\n    assert!(snap_count >= 1);\n\n    // GC with active reader must not break the reader (watermark 1 keeps all\n    // versions >= 1 — reader stays valid).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/gc\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Release the reader; GC can now reclaim old history.\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/release\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    let before = common::int(&st.body, \"file_bytes\");\n    let reclaimable = common::int(&st.body, \"reclaimable_bytes\");\n    assert!(reclaimable > 0, \"expected reclaimable bytes, got {reclaimable}\");\n\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/gc\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"ran\"), 1);\n    assert!(common::int(&r.body, \"reclaimed\") > 0);\n    assert!(common::int(&r.body, \"bytes_after\") < before);\n\n    // Latest read still correct after compaction.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"n4\"));\n\n    // New commits continue on the compacted log.\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"after\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"after\"));\n\n    // Abort path leaves nothing behind.\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/abort\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n        404\n    );\n\n    // Unknown routes / bad bodies.\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/nope\").status, 404);\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        jput(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"), \"not json\").status,\n        400\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_io_failure_returns_500_and_server_survives() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-fault\");\n\n    // Fail the sync on the first commit publication (sync #1 is header; #2 is\n    // the v1 CMMT). The HTTP layer must translate this to 500, not a crash.\n    let mut rule = FaultRule::new(FaultKind::Sync, 2);\n    rule.times = 1;\n    let rules = vec![rule];\n    let fault_engine = mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine::open_with_io(\n        Arc::new(FaultIo::new(Arc::new(StdIo), rules)),\n        &dir,\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    let server = Server::with_engine(fault_engine);\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    let addr = format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port());\n\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/stats\").status, 200);\n\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"z\",\"v\":\"1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 500);\n\n    // Server process survived: stats still answers.\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/stats\").status, 200);\n\n    // And the uncommitted v1 is invisible after a clean reopen.\n    let clean = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(clean.latest_version(), 0);\n    assert_eq!(clean.get_latest(b\"z\"), None);\n}\n\ntrait RuleTimes {\n    fn times(self, n: u32) -> Self;\n}\nimpl }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":223,"oldLines":13,"newStart":223,"newLines":3,"lines":["     assert_eq!(clean.latest_version(), 0);","     assert_eq!(clean.get_latest(b\"z\"), None);"," {"parentUuid":"06a701e3-9e14-4c65-94cc-5f0ea9df0720","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp3/a/tests/acceptance.rs","snippet":"1\t//! Acceptance suite for the stated requirements:\n2\t//!\n3\t//! 1. fixed-snapshot read consistency in the presence of concurrent commits;\n4\t//! 2. write/write conflict rejection (first committer wins);\n5\t//! 3. version reclamation never removes versions an active snapshot needs;\n6\t//! 4. once that snapshot is released, the dead bytes are actually reclaimed.\n7\t//!\n8\t//! The interleaving is driven deterministically two ways:\n9\t//! - library-level sequencing in one thread;\n10\t//! - a two-thread rendezvous through the engine's [`CommitGate`], so the\n11\t//!   conflict really happens across OS threads with the loser parked at the\n12\t//!   exact pre-publication point of the winner's commit.\n13\t\n14\tmod common;\n15\t\n16\tuse std::sync::mpsc::{channel, Receiver, Sender};\n17\tuse std::sync::Arc;\n18\t\n19\tuse mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::{CommitError, Engine};\n20\t\n21\t#[test]\n22\tfn snapshot_read_consistency() {\n23\t    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"snapshot\");\n24\t    let db = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n25\t\n26\t    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n27\t    w.put(\"a\", \"v1\");\n28\t    w.put(\"b\", \"b1\");\n29\t    let v1 = w.commit().unwrap();\n30\t    assert_eq!(v1, 1);\n31\t\n32\t    // Long reader pins version 1.\n33\t    let reader = db.begin_read();\n34\t    assert_eq!(reader.version(), 1);\n35\t\n36\t    // Newer transactions commit twice more; the reader must not see them.\n37\t    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n38\t    w.put(\"a\", \"v2\");\n39\t    w.put(\"c\", \"c2\");\n40\t    let v2 = w.commit().unwrap();\n41\t\n42\t    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n43\t    w.del(\"b\");\n44\t    w.put(\"a\", \"v3\");\n45\t    let v3 = w.commit().unwrap();\n46\t\n47\t    assert_eq!(v2, 2);\n48\t    assert_eq!(v3, 3);\n49\t\n50\t    assert_eq!(reader.get(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"v1\"[..]));\n51\t    assert_eq!(reader.get(b\"b\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"b1\"[..]));\n52\t    assert_eq!(reader.get(b\"c\"), None); // key did not exist at v1\n53\t\n54\t    // A fresh reader sees the current state.\n55\t    let fresh = db.begin_read();\n56\t    assert_eq!(fresh.get(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"v3\"[..]));\n57\t    assert_eq!(fresh.get(b\"b\"), None); Failure-injection acceptance tests using the injectable I/O layer:\n2\t//!\n3\t//! - [`mvcc_reclaim::io::FaultIo`] fails a chosen operation (write/sync/rename)\n4\t//!   after an observed operation count, returning an I/O error to the engine;\n5\t//! - [`mvcc_reclaim::io::SimCrashIo`] simulates power loss by truncating every\n6\t//!   file back to its last fsynced length.\n7\t//!\n8\t//! These verify: unpublished commits are not visible after reopening; torn\n9\t//! tails are repaired; a failed GC rename leaves the old log fully intact; an\n10\t//! injected fsync failure at publication is reported, not silently committed.\n11\t\n12\tmod common;\n13\t\n14\tuse std::fs;\n15\tuse std::io::{Read as _, Seek as _, SeekFrom, Write as _};\n16\tuse std::path::Path;\n17\tuse std::sync::Arc;\n18\t\n19\tuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, SimCrashIo, StdIo};\n20\tuse mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine;\n21\tuse mvcc_reclaim::store::{\n22\t    commit_frame_bytes, del_frame_bytes, parse_bytes, put_frame_bytes, HEADER_LEN, MAGIC,\n23\t};\n24\t\n25\tfn read_log(dir: &Path) -> Vec<u8> {\n26\t    fs::read(dir.join(\"mvcc.log\")).unwrap()\n27\t}\n28\t\n29\t#[test]\n30\tfn torn_tail_is_truncated_and_never_becomes_committed() {\n31\t    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"torn\");\n32\t\n33\t    // Commit v1 normally.\n34\t    let db = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n35\t    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n36\t    w.put(\"a\", \"1\");\n37\t    w.commit().unwrap();\n38\t    drop(db);\n39\t\n40\t    let mut good = read_log(&dir);\n41\t    let good_len = good.len() as u64;\n42\t\n43\t    // Append a *complete* v2 data record but NO CMMT (crash before publish),\n44\t    // then a few torn garbage bytes.\n45\t    let put = put_frame_bytes(2, b\"a\", b\"2\");\n46\t    let rec_off = good.len() as u64;\n47\t    good.extend_from_slice(&put);\n48\t    good.extend_from_slice(b\"\\x00\\x01garbage\"); // torn frame\n49\t    fs::write(dir.join(\"mvcc.log\"), &good).unwrap();\n50\t\n51\t    // Reopen: torn tail truncated, uncommitted PUTV removed too (it has no\n52\t    // CMMT and sits beyond the last valid frame boundary of the CMMT? (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"4312a72d-ece2-4f8b-99b6-803825c81826","timestamp":"2026-09-23T02:08:08.674Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp3/a/tests/fault_injection.rs","oldString":"use std::io::{Read as _, Seek as _, SeekFrom, Write as _};","newString":"use std::io::{Seek as _, SeekFrom, Write as _};","originalFile":"//! Failure-injection acceptance tests using the injectable I/O layer:\n//!\n//! - [`mvcc_reclaim::io::FaultIo`] fails a chosen operation (write/sync/rename)\n//!   after an observed operation count, returning an I/O error to the engine;\n//! - [`mvcc_reclaim::io::SimCrashIo`] simulates power loss by truncating every\n//!   file back to its last fsynced length.\n//!\n//! These verify: unpublished commits are not visible after reopening; torn\n//! tails are repaired; a failed GC rename leaves the old log fully intact; an\n//! injected fsync failure at publication is reported, not silently committed.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::io::{Read as _, Seek as _, SeekFrom, Write as _};\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, SimCrashIo, StdIo};\nuse mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine;\nuse mvcc_reclaim::store::{\n    commit_frame_bytes, del_frame_bytes, parse_bytes, put_frame_bytes, HEADER_LEN, MAGIC,\n};\n\nfn read_log(dir: &Path) -> Vec<u8> {\n    fs::read(dir.join(\"mvcc.log\")).unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn torn_tail_is_truncated_and_never_becomes_committed() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"torn\");\n\n    // Commit v1 normally.\n    let db = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"a\", \"1\");\n    w.commit().unwrap();\n    drop(db);\n\n    let mut good = read_log(&dir);\n    let good_len = good.len() as u64;\n\n    // Append a *complete* v2 data record but NO CMMT (crash before publish),\n    // then a few torn garbage bytes.\n    let put = put_frame_bytes(2, b\"a\", b\"2\");\n    let rec_off = good.len() as u64;\n    good.extend_from_slice(&put);\n    good.extend_from_slice(b\"\\x00\\x01garbage\"); // torn frame\n    fs::write(dir.join(\"mvcc.log\"), &good).unwrap();\n\n    // Reopen: torn tail truncated, uncommitted PUTV removed too (it has no\n    // CMMT and sits beyond the last valid frame boundary of the CMMT? No — the\n    // PUTV itself is a valid frame; the garbage is the torn part. The PUTV\n    // remains as dead bytes but is NOT a committed version.)\n    let db2 = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(db2.latest_version(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(db2.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"1\"[..]));\n\n    // The valid prefix ends right after the torn garbage was discarded: i.e.\n    // at the end of the complete-but-uncommitted PUTV.\n    let buf = read_log(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(buf.len() as u64, rec_off + put.len() as u64);\n    let parsed = parse_bytes(&buf).unwrap();\n    assert!(!parsed.torn);\n    assert_eq!(parsed.versions, vec![1]);\n    assert_eq!(parsed.records.len(), 2); End-to-end acceptance over the real HTTP entry point:\n//! two writers started on the same snapshot are interleaved with a long\n//! reader; the first commit wins, the second gets 409; GC while the reader is\n//! pinned cannot remove its history; after release the space is reclaimed.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_reclaim::http::Server;\nuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, StdIo};\n\nfn start(dir: &std::path::Path) -> String {\n    let server = Server::new(dir).unwrap();\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    // Keep the server alive for the whole test.\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port())\n}\n\nfn jget(addr: &str, path: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"GET\", path, \"\")\n}\nfn jpost(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"POST\", path, body)\n}\nfn jput(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"PUT\", path, body)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_writers_conflict_long_reader_and_gc() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-acceptance\");\n    let addr = start(&dir);\n\n    // Seed v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let w0 = common::int(&r.body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"v1\"}},{\"put\":{\"k\":\"y\",\"v\":\"y1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"buffered\"), 2);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n\n    // Long reader pins v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/read\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n    let reader = common::int(&r.body, \"read_txn_id\");\n\n    // Reader sees v1 content.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.raw.trim_matches('\"').len() > 0, true);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Writer A and B both snapshot v1.\n    let wa = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let wb = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"A\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"B\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // A commits (v2).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 2);\n\n    // B commits -> 409 conflict, names x.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"error\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"write-write conflict\"));\n    let keys = match r.body.get(\"keys\") {\n        Some(mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a)) => a\n            .iter()\n            .map(|j| j.as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n        other => panic!(\"expected keys array, got {other:?}\"),\n    };\n    assert_eq!(keys, vec![\"x\"]);\n\n    // Latest state reflects A only.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"A\"));\n\n    // The long reader STILL sees v1.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=y\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"y1\"));\n\n    // Create more history to have something reclaimable once the reader goes.\n    for i in 0..5 {\n        let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n        let body = format!(r#\"{{\"ops\":[{{\"put\":{{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"n{i}\"}}}}]}}\"#);\n        assert_eq!(jput(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"), &body).status, 200);\n        assert_eq!(\n            jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n            200\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Stats while the reader is active list it and pin watermark to 1.\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&st.body, \"watermark\"), 1);\n    let snaps = st.body.get(\"snapshots\").unwrap();\n    let snap_count = match snaps {\n        mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a) => a.len(),\n        _ => panic!(\"snapshots not array\"),\n    };\n    assert!(snap_count >= 1);\n\n    // GC with active reader must not break the reader (watermark 1 keeps all\n    // versions >= 1 — reader stays valid).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/gc\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Release the reader; GC can now reclaim old history.\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/release\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    let before = common::int(&st.body, \"file_bytes\");\n    let reclaimable = common::int(&st.body, \"reclaimable_bytes\");\n    assert!(reclaimable > 0, \"expected reclaimable bytes, got {reclaimable}\");\n\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/gc\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"ran\"), 1);\n    assert!(common::int(&r.body, \"reclaimed\") > 0);\n    assert!(common::int(&r.body, \"bytes_after\") < before);\n\n    // Latest read still correct after compaction.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"n4\"));\n\n    // New commits continue on the compacted log.\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"after\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"after\"));\n\n    // Abort path leaves nothing behind.\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/abort\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n        404\n    );\n\n    // Unknown routes / bad bodies.\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/nope\").status, 404);\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        jput(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"), \"not json\").status,\n        400\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_io_failure_returns_500_and_server_survives() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-fault\");\n\n    // Fail the sync on the first commit publication (sync #1 is header; #2 is\n    // the v1 CMMT). The HTTP layer must translate this to 500, not a crash.\n    let mut rule = FaultRule::new(FaultKind::Sync, 2);\n    rule.times = 1;\n    let rules = vec![rule];\n    let fault_engine = mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine::open_with_io(\n        Arc::new(FaultIo::new(Arc::new(StdIo), rules)),\n        &dir,\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    let server = Server::with_engine(fault_engine);\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    let addr = format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port());\n\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/stats\").status, 200);\n\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"z\",\"v\":\"1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 500);\n\n    // Server process survived: stats still answers.\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/stats\").status, 200);\n\n    // And the uncommitted v1 is invisible after a clean reopen.\n    let clean = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(clean.latest_version(), 0);\n    assert_eq!(clean.get_latest(b\"z\"), None);\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":9,"oldLines":6,"newStart":9,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," use mvcc_reclaim::http::Server;"," use mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, StdIo};","+use mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine;"," "," fn start(dir: &std::path::Path) -> String {","     let server = Server::new(dir).unwrap();"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1b55fe17-9c7b-4030-bd54-44fbd6022960","session_id":"f45b57fc-57e0-45d2-b4cb-b613f0315a0e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp3/a","sessionId":"f45b57fc-57e0-45d2-b4cb-b613f0315a0e","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp3-a","slug":"iterative-spinning-torvalds"}

The record at v1 is\n    // retained, so the reader still works, but the middle versions (2..6)\n    // are NOT reclaimable? Check: watermark = 1 means keep >= 1 ... all of\n    // them. The point is *nothing the snapshot can read* is removed.\n    let report = db.gc().unwrap().expect(\"expected some GC\");\n    assert_eq!(reader.get(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"1\"[..]));\n    // v1 is below/equal watermark floor rules: watermark=1 keeps records with\n    // version >= 1, i.e. everything; baseline may still drop duplicates below\n    // it — there are none. So reclaim here is only dead bytes.\n    assert!(report.bytes_after <= report.bytes_before);\n\n    // Release the reader: watermark jumps to latest+1 = 9; only the newest\n    // record per key is needed as baseline.\n    reader.release();\n    assert_eq!(db.watermark(), 9);\n\n    let st_before = db.stats();\n    assert!(st_before.reclaimable_bytes > 0, \"dead history should be reclaimable\");\n\n    let report = db.gc().unwrap().expect(\"expected GC after release\");\n    assert!(report.reclaimed > 0, \"space must actually be reclaimed\");\n    assert!(report.bytes_after < bytes_with_reader);\n    assert_eq!(report.watermark, 9);\n\n    // Current state is intact after compaction.\n    assert_eq!(db.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"6\"[..]));\n    assert_eq!(db.get_latest(b\"b\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(db.latest_version(), 8);\n\n    // Commits continue on top of the compacted log.\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"a\", \"after-gc\");\n    let v = w.commit().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(v, 9);\n    assert_eq!(db.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"after-gc\"[..]));\n\n    // A second GC still works with the new watermark (VSET + later CMMT path).\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"a\", \"after-gc-2\");\n    w.commit().unwrap();\n    let _ = db.gc();\n    assert_eq!(db.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"after-gc-2\"[..]));\n\n    // Restart durability of the compacted image.\n    let db2 = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(db2.latest_version(), 10);\n    assert_eq!(db2.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"after-gc-2\"[..]));\n}","new_string":"#[test]\nfn gc_preserves_active_snapshot_history_then_reclaims() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"gc\");\n    let db = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n\n    // v1..=8, each updating key `a`; add a transient key b on v7, deleted v8.\n    for i in 1..=6u64 {\n        let mut w = db.begin_write();\n        w.put(\"a\", i.to_string());\n        w.commit().unwrap();\n    }\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"b\", \"temp\");\n    w.commit().unwrap();\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.del(\"b\");\n    w.commit().unwrap(); // v8\n\n    // Long reader pins the MIDDLE version v3.\n    let reader = db.begin_read();\n    assert_eq!(reader.version(), 3);\n    assert_eq!(reader.get(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"3\"[..]));\n\n    let bytes_before = db.stats().file_bytes;\n\n    // Watermark = 3. for every version >= watermark) and v3..=8 remain.\n    let on_disk = db.committed_versions_on_disk().unwrap();\n    assert!(!on_disk.contains(&1), \"v1 should be reclaimed\");\n    assert!(on_disk.contains(&2), \"v2 baseline must survive\");\n    assert!(on_disk.contains(&3), \"the active snapshot's v3 must survive\");\n    assert!(on_disk.contains(&8));\n\n    // Latest state watermark jumps to latest+1 = 9; only the newest\n    // record per key is needed as baseline.\n    reader.release();\n    assert_eq!(db.watermark(), 9);\n\n    let st_before = db.stats();\n    assert!(st_before.reclaimable_bytes > 0, \"more history should be reclaimable\");\n\n    let report = db.gc().unwrap().expect(\"expected GC after release\");\n    assert!(report.reclaimed > 0, \"space must actually be reclaimed\");\n    assert!(report.bytes_after < bytes_before);\n    assert_eq!(report.watermark, 9);\n\n    // After full GC only versions 6 (a) and 8 (b tombstone) remain as baseline.\n    let on_disk = db.committed_versions_on_disk().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(on_disk, vec![6, 8]);\n\n    assert_eq!(db.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"6\"[..]));\n    assert_eq!(db.get_latest(b\"b\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(db.latest_version(), 8);\n\n    // Commits continue on top of the compacted log.\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"a\", \"after-gc\");\n    let v = w.commit().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(v, 9);\n    assert_eq!(db.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"after-gc\"[..]));\n\n    // A second GC still works with the new watermark (VSET + later CMMT path).\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"a\", \"after-gc-2\");\n    w.commit().unwrap();\n    let _ = db.gc();\n    assert_eq!(db.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"after-gc-2\"[..]));\n\n    // Restart durability of the compacted image.\n    let db2 = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(db2.latest_version(), 10);\n    assert_eq!(db2.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"after-gc-2\"[..]));\n}"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d45ab3c80ca96cd2557f4696","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1568,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":118584,"output_tokens":2172,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_n64bbqgghyxw70cpaxehub19":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp3/a/tests/acceptance.rs","new_string":"#[test]\nfn Failure-injection acceptance tests using the injectable I/O layer:\n//!\n//! - [`mvcc_reclaim::io::FaultIo`] fails a chosen operation (write/sync/rename)\n//!   after an observed operation count, returning an I/O error to the engine;\n//! - [`mvcc_reclaim::io::SimCrashIo`] simulates power loss by truncating every\n//!   file back to its last fsynced length.\n//!\n//! These verify: unpublished commits are not visible after reopening; torn\n//! tails are repaired; a failed GC rename leaves the old log fully intact; an\n//! injected fsync failure at publication is reported, not silently committed.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::io::{Seek as _, SeekFrom, Write as _};\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, SimCrashIo, StdIo};\nuse mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine;\nuse mvcc_reclaim::store::{\n    commit_frame_bytes, del_frame_bytes, parse_bytes, put_frame_bytes, HEADER_LEN, MAGIC,\n};\n\nfn read_log(dir: &Path) -> Vec<u8> {\n    fs::read(dir.join(\"mvcc.log\")).unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn torn_tail_is_truncated_and_never_becomes_committed() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"torn\");\n\n    // Commit v1 normally.\n    let db = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"a\", \"1\");\n    w.commit().unwrap();\n    drop(db);\n\n    let mut good = read_log(&dir);\n    let good_len = good.len() as u64;\n\n    // Append a *complete* v2 data record but NO CMMT (crash before publish),\n    // then a few torn garbage bytes.\n    let put = put_frame_bytes(2, b\"a\", b\"2\");\n    let rec_off = good.len() as u64;\n    good.extend_from_slice(&put);\n    good.extend_from_slice(b\"\\x00\\x01garbage\"); // torn frame\n    fs::write(dir.join(\"mvcc.log\"), &good).unwrap();\n\n    // Reopen: torn tail truncated, uncommitted PUTV removed too (it has no\n    // CMMT and sits beyond the last valid frame boundary of the CMMT? No — the\n    // PUTV itself is a valid frame; the garbage is the torn part. The PUTV\n    // remains as dead bytes but is NOT a committed version.)\n    let db2 = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(db2.latest_version(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(db2.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"1\"[..]));\n\n    // The valid prefix ends right after the torn garbage was discarded: i.e.\n    // at the end of the complete-but-uncommitted PUTV.\n    let buf = read_log(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(buf.len() as u64, rec_off + put.len() as u64);\n    let parsed = parse_bytes(&buf).unwrap();\n    assert!(!parsed.torn);\n    assert_eq!(parsed.versions, vec![1]);\n    assert_eq!(parsed.records.len(), 2); // v1 and dead v2 record\n    assert!(good_len > 0);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn simulated_power_loss_discards_unsynced_commit() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"crash\");\n    let crash = Arc::new(SimCrashIo::new(Arc::new(StdIo)));\n\n    // v1 durable.\n    let db = Engine::open_with_io(crash.clone() as Arc<dyn mvcc_reclaim::io::Io>, &dir).unwrap();\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"a\", \"durable\");\n    w.commit().unwrap();\n\n    // Hand-craft a fully-written but unsynced v2 (data + CMMT), exactly as the\n    // page cache would hold it after a crash: append to the underlying file,\n    // but the simulator's last-synced length stays at the v1 boundary.\n    {\n        let synced = db.stats().file_bytes; // post-v1 length (handle was synced)\n        let _ = synced;\n    }\n    let v1_len = {\n        let parsed = parse_bytes(&read_log(&dir)).unwrap();\n        parsed.valid_len\n    };\n    let data = put_frame_bytes(2, b\"a\", b\"lost\");\n    let cmmt = commit_frame_bytes(2, v1_len);\n    let mut f = fs::OpenOptions::new()\n        .read(true)\n        .write(true)\n        .open(dir.join(\"mvcc.log\"))\n        .unwrap();\n    f.seek(SeekFrom::End(0)).unwrap();\n    f.write_all(&data).unwrap();\n    f.write_all(&cmmt).unwrap();\n    // Crucially: no fsync, and the simulator did not register this handle.\n    drop(f);\n\n    // Power loss: truncate back to the last synced length.\n    crash.crash();\n\n    let buf = read_log(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(buf.len() as u64, v1_len);\n\n    let db2 = Engine::open_with_io(crash.clone() as Arc<dyn mvcc_reclaim::io::Io>, &dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(db2.latest_version(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(db2.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"durable\"[..]));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_sync_failure_at_publish_is_not_committed() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"syncfail\");\n\n    // Count syncs: the file-header sync (1) then each commit's publish sync.\n    // Fail the sync of the very first commit publication => v1 must abort and\n    // the store must not think v1 exists after reopen.\n    let rules = vec![FaultRule::new(FaultKind::Sync, 2)]; // 1 = header sync\n    let io = Arc::new(FaultIo::new(Arc::new(StdIo), rules));\n    let db = Engine::open_with_io(io, &dir).unwrap();\n\n    let mut w = db.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"a\", \"1\");\n    let res = w.commit();\n    assert!(res.is_err(), \"commit must surface the fsync error\");\n\n    // Drop the handle and reopen with a clean I/O layer: v1 never published.\n    drop(db);\n    let db2 = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(db2.latest_version(), 0);\n    assert_eq!(db2.get_latest(b\"a\"), None);\n\n    // The file may contain the uncommitted data frame (dead bytes); a later\n    // successful commit simply allocates version 1 and works fine.\n    let mut w = db2.begin_write();\n    w.put(\"a\", \"real-v1\");\n    assert_eq!(w.commit().unwrap(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(db2.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"real-v1\"[..]));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn failed_gc_rename_keeps_old_log_intact_and_working() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"gcrename\");\n    let db = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    for i in 0..6u64 {\n        let mut w = db.begin_write();\n        w.put(\"a\", i.to_string());\n        w.commit().unwrap();\n    }\n    drop(db);\n\n    // Rename count during GC: first rename is `log -> old`. Fail it.\n    let rules = vec![FaultRule::new(FaultKind::Rename, 1)];\n    let io = Arc::new(FaultIo::new(Arc::new(StdIo), rules));\n    let db = Engine::open_with_io(io, &dir).unwrap();\n    let res = db.gc();\n    assert!(res.is_err(), \"GC must surface the rename failure\");\n\n    // Old log is untouched and immediately usable.\n    drop(db);\n    let db2 = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(db2.latest_version(), 6);\n    assert_eq!(db2.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"5\"[..]));\n    // Stale temp file from the failed GC must be cleaned up on open.\n    let mut temps = 0;\n    for e in fs::read_dir(&dir).unwrap().flatten() {\n        if e.file_name().to_string_lossy().contains(\".tmp.\") {\n            temps += 1;\n        }\n    }\n    assert_eq!(temps, 0);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn failed_second_gc_rename_recovers_on_reopen() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"gcrename2\");\n    let db = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    for i in 0..4u64 {\n        let mut w = db.begin_write();\n        w.put(\"a\", i.to_string());\n        w.commit().unwrap();\n    }\n    drop(db);\n\n    // Two renames occur in one GC (log->old, tmp->log). Fail the second one.\n    let rules = vec![FaultRule::new(FaultKind::Rename, 2)];\n    let io = Arc::new(FaultIo::new(Arc::new(StdIo), rules));\n    let db = Engine::open_with_io(io, &dir).unwrap();\n    assert!(db.gc().is_err());\n    drop(db);\n\n    // Recovery point after first rename: mvcc.old exists (the previous log),\n    // and mvcc.log is missing. Open must rename old back to log.\n    assert!(!dir.join(\"mvcc.log\").exists());\n    assert!(dir.join(\"mvcc.old\").exists());\n    let db2 = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(db2.latest_version(), 4);\n    assert_eq!(db2.get_latest(b\"a\").as_deref(), Some(&b\"3\"[..]));\n    assert!(dir.join(\"mvcc.log\").exists());\n    assert!(!dir.join(\"mvcc.old\").exists());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn malformed_magic_is_rejected() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"magic\");\n    fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    fs::write(dir.join(\"mvcc.log\"), b\"NOTMVCCDATA\").unwrap();\n    assert!(Engine::open(&dir).is_err());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn frame_roundtrip_includes_crc_and_version() {\n    let put = put_frame_bytes(7, b\"k\", b\"v\");\n    let parsed = parse_bytes(&{\n        let mut b = MAGIC.to_vec();\n        b.push(1);\n        b.extend_from_slice(&put);\n        b\n    })\n    .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(parsed.records.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(parsed.records[0].version, 7);\n    assert_eq!(parsed.records[0].key, b\"k\");\n    assert_eq!(parsed.records[0].value.as_deref(), Some(&b\"v\"[..]));\n\n    // Corrupting one payload byte fails CRC => torn, zero valid records.\n    let mut bad = MAGIC.to_vec();\n    bad.push(1);\n    let mut frame = put.clone();\n    let n = frame.len();\n    frame[n - End-to-end acceptance over the real HTTP entry point:\n//! two writers started on the same snapshot are interleaved with a long\n//! reader; the first commit wins, the second gets 409; GC while the reader is\n//! pinned cannot remove its history; after release the space is reclaimed.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_reclaim::http::Server;\nuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, StdIo};\nuse mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine;\n\nfn start(dir: &std::path::Path) -> String {\n    let server = Server::new(dir).unwrap();\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    // Keep the server alive for the whole test.\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port())\n}\n\nfn jget(addr: &str, path: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"GET\", path, \"\")\n}\nfn jpost(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"POST\", path, body)\n}\nfn jput(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"PUT\", path, body)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_writers_conflict_long_reader_and_gc() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-acceptance\");\n    let addr = start(&dir);\n\n    // Seed v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let w0 = common::int(&r.body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"v1\"}},{\"put\":{\"k\":\"y\",\"v\":\"y1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"buffered\"), 2);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n\n    // Long reader pins v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/read\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n    let reader = common::int(&r.body, \"read_txn_id\");\n\n    // Reader sees v1 content.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.raw.trim_matches('\"').len() > 0, true);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Writer A and B both snapshot v1.\n    let wa = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let wb = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"A\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"B\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // A commits (v2).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 2);\n\n    // B commits -> 409 conflict, names x.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"error\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"write-write conflict\"));\n    let keys = match r.body.get(\"keys\") {\n        Some(mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a)) => a\n            .iter()\n            .map(|j| j.as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n        other => panic!(\"expected keys array, got {other:?}\"),\n    };\n    assert_eq!(keys, vec![\"x\"]);\n\n    // Latest state reflects A only.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"A\"));\n\n    // The long reader STILL sees v1.\n    let r = End-to-end acceptance over the real HTTP entry point:\n//! two writers started on the same snapshot are interleaved with a long\n//! reader; the first commit wins, the second gets 409; GC while the reader is\n//! pinned cannot remove its history; after release the space is reclaimed.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_reclaim::http::Server;\nuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, StdIo};\nuse mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine;\n\nfn start(dir: &std::path::Path) -> String {\n    let server = Server::new(dir).unwrap();\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    // Keep the server alive for the whole test.\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port())\n}\n\nfn jget(addr: &str, path: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"GET\", path, \"\")\n}\nfn jpost(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"POST\", path, body)\n}\nfn jput(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"PUT\", path, body)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_writers_conflict_long_reader_and_gc() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-acceptance\");\n    let addr = start(&dir);\n\n    // Seed v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let w0 = common::int(&r.body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}\"),\n End-to-end acceptance over the real HTTP entry point:\n//! two writers started on the same snapshot are interleaved with a long\n//! reader; the first commit wins, the second gets 409; GC while the reader is\n//! pinned cannot remove its history; after release the space is reclaimed.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_reclaim::http::Server;\nuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule, StdIo};\nuse mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine;\n\nfn start(dir: &std::path::Path) -> String {\n    let server = Server::new(dir).unwrap();\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    // Keep the server alive for the whole test.\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port())\n}\n\nfn jget(addr: &str, path: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"GET\", path, \"\")\n}\nfn jpost(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"POST\", path, body)\n}\nfn jput(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"PUT\", path, body)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_writers_conflict_long_reader_and_gc() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-acceptance\");\n    let addr = start(&dir);\n\n    // Seed v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let w0 = common::int(&r.body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"v1\"}},{\"put\":{\"k\":\"y\",\"v\":\"y1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"buffered\"), 2);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n\n    // Long reader pins v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/read\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n    let reader = common::int(&r.body, \"read_txn_id\");\n\n    // Reader sees v1 content.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.raw.trim_matches('\"').len() > 0, true);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Writer A and B both snapshot v1.\n    let wa = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let wb = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"A\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"B\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // A commits (v2).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 2);\n\n    // B commits -> 409 conflict, names x.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"error\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"write-write conflict\"));\n    let keys = match r.body.get(\"keys\") {\n        Some(mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a)) => a\n            .iter()\n            .map(|j| j.as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n        other => panic!(\"expected keys array, got {other:?}\"),\n    };\n    assert_eq!(keys, vec![\"x\"]);\n\n    // Latest state reflects A only.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"A\"));\n\n    // The long reader STILL sees v1.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=y\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"y1\"));\n\n    // Create more history to have something reclaimable once the reader goes.\n    for i in 0..5 {\n        let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n        let body = format!(r#\"{{\"ops\":[{{\"put\":{{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"n{i}\"}}}}]}}\"#);\n        assert_eq!(jput(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"), &body).status, 200);\n        assert_eq!(\n            jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n            200\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Stats while the reader is active list it and pin watermark to 1.\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&st.body, \"watermark\"), 1);\n    let snaps = st.body.get(\"snapshots\").unwrap();\n    let snap_count = match snaps {\n        mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a) => a.len(),\n        _ => panic!(\"snapshots not array\"),\n    };\n    assert!(snap_count >= 1);\n\n    // GC with active reader must not break the reader (watermark 1 keeps all\n    // versions >= 1 — reader stays valid).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/gc\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Release the reader; GC can now reclaim old history.\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/release\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    let before = common::int(&st.body, \"file_bytes\");\n    let reclaimable = common::int(&st.body, \"reclaimable_bytes\");\n    assert!(reclaimable > 0, \"expected reclaimable bytes, got {reclaimable}\");\n\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/gc\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let ran = match r.body.get(\"ran\") {\n        Some(mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Bool(b)) => *b,\n        other => panic!(\"ran not bool: {other:?}\"),\n    };\n    assert!(ran, \"GC should reclaim old history\");\n    assert!(common::int(&r.body, \"reclaimed\") > 0);\n    assert!(common::int(&r.body, \"bytes_after\") < before);\n\n    // Latest read still correct after compaction.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"n4\"));\n\n    // New commits continue on the compacted log.\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"after\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"after\"));\n\n    // Abort path leaves nothing behind.\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/abort\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n        404\n    );\n\n    // Unknown routes / bad bodies.\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/nope\").status, 404);\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        jput(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"), \"not json\").status,\n        400\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_io_failure_returns_500_and_server_survives() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-fault\");\n\n    // Fail the sync on the first commit publication (sync #1 is header; #2 is\n    // the v1 CMMT). The HTTP layer must translate this to 500, not a crash.\n    // Stack SimCrashIo underneath so a reopen after the failed fsync sees the\n    // bytes lost (as real power loss would behave).\n    let crash = Arc::new(mvcc_reclaim::io::SimCrashIo::new(Arc::new(mvcc_reclaim::io::StdIo)));\n    let mut rule = FaultRule::new(FaultKind::Sync, 2);\n    rule.times = 1;\n    let rules = vec![rule];\n    let fault_engine = mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine::open_with_io(\n        Arc::new(FaultIo::new(crash.clone() as Arc<dyn mvcc_reclaim::io::Io>, rules)),\n        &dir,\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    let server = Server::with_engine(fault_engine);\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    let addr = format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port());\n\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/stats\").status, 200);\n\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"z\",\"v\":\"1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 500);\n\n    // Server survived: stats still answers.\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/stats\").status, 200);\n\n    // Simulate the power loss the failed fsync represents, then reopen clean.\n    crash.crash();\n    let clean = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(clean.latest_version(), 0);\n    assert_eq!(clean.get_latest(b\"z\"), End-to-end acceptance over the real HTTP entry point:\n//! two writers started on the same snapshot are interleaved with a long\n//! reader; the first commit wins, the second gets 409; GC while the reader is\n//! pinned cannot remove its history; after release the space is reclaimed.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_reclaim::http::Server;\nuse mvcc_reclaim::io::{FaultIo, FaultKind, FaultRule};\nuse mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine;\n\nfn start(dir: &std::path::Path) -> String {\n    let server = Server::new(dir).unwrap();\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    // Keep the server alive for the whole test.\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port())\n}\n\nfn jget(addr: &str, path: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"GET\", path, \"\")\n}\nfn jpost(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"POST\", path, body)\n}\nfn jput(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    common::http(addr, \"PUT\", path, body)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_writers_conflict_long_reader_and_gc() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-acceptance\");\n    let addr = start(&dir);\n\n    // Seed v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let w0 = common::int(&r.body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"v1\"}},{\"put\":{\"k\":\"y\",\"v\":\"y1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"buffered\"), 2);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{w0}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n\n    // Long reader pins v1.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/tx/read\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 1);\n    let reader = common::int(&r.body, \"read_txn_id\");\n\n    // Reader sees v1 content.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.raw.trim_matches('\"').len() > 0, true);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Writer A and B both snapshot v1.\n    let wa = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let wb = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"A\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"B\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // A commits (v2).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wa}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&r.body, \"version\"), 2);\n\n    // B commits -> 409 conflict, names x.\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wb}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"error\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"write-write conflict\"));\n    let keys = match r.body.get(\"keys\") {\n        Some(mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a)) => a\n            .iter()\n            .map(|j| j.as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n        other => panic!(\"expected keys array, got {other:?}\"),\n    };\n    assert_eq!(keys, vec![\"x\"]);\n\n    // Latest state reflects A only.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"A\"));\n\n    // The long reader STILL sees v1.\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=y\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"y1\"));\n\n    // Create more history to have something reclaimable once the reader goes.\n    for i in 0..5 {\n        let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n        let body = format!(r#\"{{\"ops\":[{{\"put\":{{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"n{i}\"}}}}]}}\"#);\n        assert_eq!(jput(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"), &body).status, 200);\n        assert_eq!(\n            jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n            200\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Stats while the reader is active list it and pin watermark to 1.\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    assert_eq!(common::int(&st.body, \"watermark\"), 1);\n    let snaps = st.body.get(\"snapshots\").unwrap();\n    let snap_count = match snaps {\n        mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Arr(a) => a.len(),\n        _ => panic!(\"snapshots not array\"),\n    };\n    assert!(snap_count >= 1);\n\n    // GC with active reader must not break the reader (watermark 1 keeps all\n    // versions >= 1 — reader stays valid).\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/gc\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jget(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/get?key=x\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"v1\"));\n\n    // Release the reader; GC can now reclaim old history.\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/read/{reader}/release\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    let st = jget(&addr, \"/stats\");\n    let before = common::int(&st.body, \"file_bytes\");\n    let reclaimable = common::int(&st.body, \"reclaimable_bytes\");\n    assert!(reclaimable > 0, \"expected reclaimable bytes, got {reclaimable}\");\n\n    let r = jpost(&addr, \"/gc\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let ran = match r.body.get(\"ran\") {\n        Some(mvcc_reclaim::json::Json::Bool(b)) => *b,\n        other => panic!(\"ran not bool: {other:?}\"),\n    };\n    assert!(ran, \"GC should reclaim old history\");\n    assert!(common::int(&r.body, \"reclaimed\") > 0);\n    assert!(common::int(&r.body, \"bytes_after\") < before);\n\n    // Latest read still correct after compaction.\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"n4\"));\n\n    // New commits continue on the compacted log.\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"after\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jget(&addr, \"/get?key=x\");\n    assert_eq!(r.body.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()), Some(\"after\"));\n\n    // Abort path leaves nothing behind.\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/abort\"), \"{}\").status,\n        200\n    );\n    assert_eq!(\n        jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\").status,\n        404\n    );\n\n    // Unknown routes / bad bodies.\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/nope\").status, 404);\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        jput(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"), \"not json\").status,\n        400\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_io_failure_returns_500_and_server_survives() {\n    let dir = common::temp_dir(\"http-fault\");\n\n    // Fail the sync on the first commit publication (sync #1 is header; #2 is\n    // the v1 CMMT). The HTTP layer must translate this to 500, not a crash.\n    // Stack SimCrashIo underneath so a reopen after the failed fsync sees the\n    // bytes lost (as real power loss would behave).\n    let crash = Arc::new(mvcc_reclaim::io::SimCrashIo::new(Arc::new(mvcc_reclaim::io::StdIo)));\n    let mut rule = FaultRule::new(FaultKind::Sync, 2);\n    rule.times = 1;\n    let rules = vec![rule];\n    let fault_engine = mvcc_reclaim::mvcc::Engine::open_with_io(\n        Arc::new(FaultIo::new(crash.clone() as Arc<dyn mvcc_reclaim::io::Io>, rules)),\n        &dir,\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    let server = Server::with_engine(fault_engine);\n    let addr = server.serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    std::mem::forget(server);\n    let addr = format!(\"127.0.0.1:{}\", addr.port());\n\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/stats\").status, 200);\n\n    let wid = common::int(&jpost(&addr, \"/tx/write\", \"{}\").body, \"write_txn_id\");\n    let r = jput(\n        &addr,\n        &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}\"),\n        r#\"{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"z\",\"v\":\"1\"}}]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = jpost(&addr, &format!(\"/tx/write/{wid}/commit\"), \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 500);\n\n    // Server survived: stats still answers.\n    assert_eq!(jget(&addr, \"/stats\").status, 200);\n\n    // Simulate the power loss the failed fsync represents, then reopen clean.\n    crash.crash();\n    let clean = Engine::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(clean.latest_version(), 0);\n    assert_eq!(clean.get_latest(b\"z\"), None);\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":57,"oldLines":7,"newStart":57,"newLines":6,"lines":[" ","     // Reader sees v1 content.","     let r = jget(&addr, {"parentUuid":"67babd09-c48b-4113-95d9-c48fed959c34","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_m2wj59yzg0kj2v723jz8mso8","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp3/a/examples/demo.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Manual acceptance walkthrough over the local HTTP entry point.\n# Requires a running server:  ./target/release/mvcc-server --dir /tmp/mvcc-demo\n# Requires curl (jq optional, only used for pretty printing).\nset -u\nBASE=\"${BASE:-http://127.0.0.1:18080}\"\npp() { if command -v jq >/dev/null; then jq -c . ; else cat; fi; }\nreq() { # METHOD PATH [BODY]\n  local m=\"$1\" p=\"$2\" b=\"${3:-}\"\n  echo \"-- $m $p ${b:+  body: $b}\"\n  if [ -n \"$b\" ]; then\n    curl -s -X \"$m\" \"$BASE$p\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d \"$b\" -w '   [HTTP %{http_code}]\\n' | { pp 2>/dev/null || cat; }\n  else\n    curl -s -X \"$m\" \"$BASE$p\" -w '   [HTTP %{http_code}]\\n' | { pp 2>/dev/null || cat; }\n  fi\n}\n\necho '### seed v1: x=v1, y=y1'\nW0=$(curl -s -X POST \"$BASE/tx/write\" -d '{}' | jq -r .write_txn_id)\nreq PUT  \"/tx/write/$W0\" '{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"v1\"}},{\"put\":{\"k\":\"y\",\"v\":\"y1\"}}]}'\nreq POST \"/tx/write/$W0/commit\" '{}'\n\necho; echo '### long reader pins v1'\nR=$(curl -s -X POST \"$BASE/tx/read\" -d '{}' | tee /dev/stderr | jq -r .read_txn_id) 2>/dev/null\nR=$(curl -s -X POST \"$BASE/tx/read\" -d '{}' | jq -r .read_txn_id)\nreq GET  \"/tx/read/$R/get?key=x\"\n\necho; echo '### writers A and B both start on snapshot v1, both touch x'\nWA=$(curl -s -X POST \"$BASE/tx/write\" -d '{}' | jq -r .write_txn_id)\nWB=$(curl -s -X POST \"$BASE/tx/write\" -d '{}' | jq -r .write_txn_id)\nreq PUT  \"/tx/write/$WA\" '{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"A\"}}]}'\nreq PUT  \"/tx/write/$WB\" '{\"ops\":[{\"put\":{\"k\":\"x\",\"v\":\"B\"}}]}'\nreq POST \"/tx/write/$WA/commit\" '{}'\nreq POST \"/tx/write/$WB/commit\" '{}'   # expect 409 conflict\n\necho; echo '### latest read shows A; the long reader still sees v1'\nreq GET  \"/get?key=x\"\nreq GET  \"/tx/read/$R/get?key=x\"\nreq GET  \"/tx/read/$R/get?key=y\"\n\necho; echo '### add history v4..v8'\nfor i in 3 4 5 6 7; do\n  W=$(curl -s -X POST \"$BASE/tx/write\" -d '{}' | jq -r .write_txn_id)\n  curl -s -X PUT \"$BASE/tx/write/$W\" -d \"{\\\"ops\\\":[{\\\"put\\\":{\\\"k\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"v\\\":\\\"n$i\\\"}}]}\" >/dev/null\n  curl -s -X POST \"$BASE/tx/write/$W/commit\" -d '{}' | jq -c '{committed,version}'\ndone\n\necho; echo '### stats with the reader active (watermark pinned to 1)'\nreq GET \"/stats\"\necho; echo '### GC while reader active, then reader re-check'\nreq POST \"/gc\" '{}'\nreq GET  \"/tx/read/$R/get?key=x\"\n\necho; echo '### release reader; watermark moves; GC now reclaims'\nreq POST \"/tx/read/$R/release\" '{}'\nreq GET  \"/stats\"\nreq POST \"/gc\" '{}'\nreq GET  \"/get?key=x\"\nreq GET  \"/stats\"\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e6998aae99859899b904890c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":671,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":131896,"output_tokens":1086,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_m2wj59yzg0kj2v723jz8mso8":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Manual acceptance walkthrough over the local HTTP entry point.\n# Requires a running server:  ./target/release/mvcc-server --dir /tmp/mvcc-demo\n# Requires curl (jq optional, only used for pretty printing).\nset -u\nBASE=\"${BASE:-http://127.0.0.1:18080}\"\npp() { if command -v jq >/dev/null;
